name: 顾栖月
persona: 北荒旧门第遗孤 / 王府隐线暗卫（花神，玉笛，高武写实）
identity: 苏梦城麾下近身暗卫（节奏扰敌/近身补杀）

origin_timeline.early_status: 北荒高官之女，容貌出众，善笛。
origin_timeline.tragedy_trigger: 北荒皇帝欲强纳入宫被拒，随后其家门被灭。
origin_timeline.turning_point: 她归来复线时与苏梦城相交，苏梦城赠其寒玉笛【玉尘】。
origin_timeline.jianghu_phase: 三年后，江湖现“花神”绝色美人，以音律控节奏并完成致命收束。
origin_timeline.retreat_phase: “花神”名动一时后主动隐退江湖，转入王府暗线行动。

personality_profile.inner_conflict: 擅长诱敌与误导，但对无意义折磨目标有底线。
personality_profile.expression_style: 常带浅笑，真正动手前反而更安静。
personality_profile.speech_style: 语气轻，信息密，常以反问试探对方底牌。

visual_specs.facial_features: Calm eyes with sharp focus, natural skin texture, no heavy makeup.
visual_specs.hair: Neat dark hair in a practical half-up style with hidden tie.
visual_specs.outfit: Dark-green and ink-black fitted travel robe, split hem for agile footwork, light leather belt rig.

wardrobe.name: 月影流光 (Palace Fairy)
wardrobe.description: 月白色蝉翼纱外罩，内衬银丝织锦内衫。强调不可捉摸的流光质感。

wardrobe.name: 寒梅映雪 (Winter Fairy)
wardrobe.description: 珍珠白哑光缎面配黑狼毫领大氅，手持墨色青油纸伞。傲雪凌霜。

wardrobe.name: 云丝鹤羽 (Celestial Battle-Dress)
wardrobe.description: 云母白缂丝长袍镶嵌白鹤羽片。眉宇英气，仙姿冷冽。

visual_specs.weapon: Primary: mutton-fat jade transverse flute '玉尘' (lustrous carved pattern, green-jade tassel, combat-grade; can parry and strike). No secondary weapon.
visual_specs.distinguishing_marks: Finger calluses from flute control and close-quarters grip transitions.

combat_profile.style: Rhythm breaks, angle entries, precise short-range lethal windows
